metadata.name: CSU Chico provisional outdoor walking graph
metadata.status: manual review required; node-level barriers and access tags unavailable

source.query: Campus-area highway ways from scripts/fetch-osm-campus-map.mjs; no wider street network
source.nodeTagRetrieval: Single bounded historical Overpass query timed out on 2026-10-25; no supplemental data received.

origin.description: Existing OSM footway node; outdoor coordinate origin only, unrelated to indoor origins.

projection.method: Local WGS84 linearization at campus reference latitude; suitable for campus-scale approximate horizontal distances
projection.axes: positive X east; positive Y north

conventions.ids: outdoor-0-osm-<OSM node ID>; new outdoor convention
conventions.floor: 0 denotes outdoors for the existing numeric floorId contract; buildingId is null
conventions.distance: Loader derives every distance from endpoint positions; weight 1; stairs omit vertical rise
conventions.geometry: RDP tolerance 0.5 feet, preserving endpoints and every node shared with another source highway; no proximity snapping or inferred crossings
conventions.access: Footway/steps presumed walkable unless restricted; cycleways and service roads require explicit foot=yes/designated/permissive. Mode-specific foot permission overrides general access. Ordinary vehicle roads excluded.
conventions.accessibility: Stairs and explicit wheelchair=no are false; otherwise unknown. No true flags, no accessible-routing claim.
conventions.boundaries: Uses pedestrian features in the collected campus-area export; boundary coverage and disconnected fragments remain provisional.

uncertainties: Missing node-level entrance, barrier, gate, kerb and access tags affect the entire graph.
This file contains outdoor geometry only; building entrance connections and geographic alignment are stored separately.
Shared-node topology retained; geometric line intersections do not create connections.
Disconnected components deliberately retained for review; no invented links.
OSM snapshot does not establish current closures, opening hours or access permissions.
Indoor corridors, rough trails, unapproved cycleways and most vehicle roads excluded; missing outdoor alternatives may cause legitimate route failures.
